item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Shakshuka – a lovely spiced tomato stew with vegetables and chickpeas, served with egg and topped with a fresh-herb salad. With salted yoghurt and pita bread. (1+2+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Pasta alla Norma – a classic Italian pasta dish with baked aubergine, tomato sauce and fresh basil, topped with salted ricotta cream. With a fresh, tangy Italian green salad and help-yourself olives. Also served gluten free. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Classic red lentil dal served with rice, raita and mango chutney. (6+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Vegetable lasagne with a creamy mornay sauce. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Creamy autumn vegetable soup with plenty of autumn vegetables and cream, topped with green oil and cress. With rosemary focaccia, whipped ricotta cream and a warm beetroot salad with lentils and walnuts. Also served gluten free. (1+6+9+15)
